title: My God is so BIG
textBlocks:
What a Mighty God I serve
Hello Bravehearts, 
in today’s story
 the Lord reminds the Israelites 
about all the miracles He did 
and how He protected them

The 10 plaques were God miracles
The crossing of the Red Sea
The crossing of the Jordan River
And helping them win battles with enemy

They see what God has done, 
how he protected and saved them and they 
make a PROMISE
To serve God only

THEY CHOSE TO OUT GOD FIRST

JOSHUA 24.23
Ask your mom to draw or download, print, decorate and cut out
